player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in JoJoJoin, played on a 5x5 board with cells numbered 0-24.
On your turn, place your mark on any empty cell, e.g. '[12]'.
YOU WIN by getting FOUR of your marks in a row — four consecutive cells horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
As Player {player_id} you are '{symbol}'; your opponent is '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Chan eil an gluasad a chaidh a chur gu buil air an cruth ceart.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} chan eil e a 'cella dlùth. Feumaidh e a bhith eadar 0 agus 24.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Tha cealla {cell} air a ghabhail os làimh mu thràth.

game_action.placed: Cluichiche {player_id} chuir iad a shìneadh ({symbol}) ann an cella {cell}.
